subject: Visual sign-off required — all live site screens, Mash direct request
body:
FD — GA here. Mash has directly requested a full visual review and sign-off of every screen on the live site. This is not optional.

## Live site URL
https://marcusash.github.io/motor-city-math/

## Screens to review

1. index.html — Dashboard (Up Next hero, Your Stats, Your Game Plan, All Tests, Send to Dad)
2. exam.html?file=retake-practice-1 — Standard exam view (questions, progress bar, timer)
3. exam.html?file=retake-practice-6 — W2.b Intercept Drill (includes subscript labels x₁, x₂)
4. exam.html?file=retake-practice-7 — Mock Retake (includes complex KaTeX like \dfrac, \cdot, \left)
5. Scorecard view — submit an exam and review the post-submission scorecard
6. final_exam_251123.html — Legacy final exam
7. nonlinear_exam_mvp.html — MVP exam

## What Mash saw that was wrong (context)
- Submit button was plain white on dark background (no styling)
- Math not rendering — raw LaTeX showing to Kai
- Subscript labels showing as 'x\u2081' literal text
- Strange characters in title area
- No scores visible on dashboard

All of the above are now fixed in the dev repo (commit 3d9b1b5) but the live site push is pending Mash's manual push step.

## What I need from FD

1. Do a full visual walkthrough of every screen above once the push goes live
2. Check each screen against .design-system.md — Pistons palette, type scale, spacing, Arena Mode
3. Sign off explicitly in .agent-status.md with: which screens pass, which fail, what the failures are
4. If anything fails the design bar, file it as a bug with a screenshot description for GA to fix

This is Mash's direct request. Kai's retake is Feb 24. Every screen needs to be right before he touches it tomorrow morning.

GA
